briefTitle: A Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Divarasib and Pembrolizumab Versus Pembrolizumab and Pemetrexed and Carboplatin or Cisplatin in Participants With Previously Untreated, KRAS G12C-Mutated, Advanced or Metastatic Non-Squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease, as defined by RECIST v1.1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No prior systemic treatment for advanced or metastatic NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior systemic treatment restriction lacks a numeric line limit or standard prior_lines format.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Documentation of known PD-L1 expression status in tumor tissue
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: PD-L1 status is required as known/documented, but no specific minimum or maximum threshold is specified.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate end-organ function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General end-organ function without specific numeric laboratory cutoffs cannot be mapped to typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Eligible to receive a platinum-based chemotherapy regimen
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator judgment of eligibility for platinum-based therapy is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known concomitant second oncogenic driver with available targeted treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of a second oncogenic driver is a general judgment call rather than a single specific biomarker check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Spinal cord compression not definitively treated with surgery and/or radiation or previously diagnosed and treated spinal cord compression without evidence that disease has been clinically stable for >=2 weeks prior to randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Spinal cord compression status and stability window are complex clinical conditions not covered by standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of leptomeningeal disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Leptomeningeal disease is a specific metastatic site exclusion without a typed representation.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Uncontrolled pleural effusion, pericardial effusion, or ascites requiring recurrent drainage procedures (once a month or more frequently)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Uncontrolled effusions with frequency criteria are clinical judgments outside standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any anti-cancer systemic therapy, including hormonal therapy, within 21 days prior to randomization, or is expected to require any other form of antineoplastic therapy while in the study
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Systemic therapy washout window is complex and involves multiple therapy classes.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Radiation therapy including palliative RT to bone metastases within 2 weeks prior to randomization and RT to the lung >30Gy within 6 months prior to randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Radiation therapy washout and dose thresholds cannot be represented with typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Treatment with systemic immunosuppressive or immunostimulatory medications, including CD137 agonists and immune checkpoint inhibitors
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of various categories of immunosuppressive or immunostimulatory agents.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Current treatment with medications that are well known to prolong the QT interval
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concomitant medications prolonging QT interval are not a simple typed exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Treatment with therapeutic oral or IV antibiotics within 2 weeks prior to randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Antibiotic use restriction is not covered by the allowed typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior allogeneic stem cell or solid organ transplantation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Transplantation history is not a typed exclusion kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of malignancy other than NSCLC within 5 years prior to screening, with the exception of malignancies with a negligible risk of metastasis or death (e.g., 5-year overall survival [OS] rate >90%), such as adequately treated carcinoma in situ of the cervix, non melanoma skin carcinoma, localized prostate cancer, ductal breast carcinoma in situ, or Stage I uterine cancer
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior malignancy history with complex exceptions is a clinical judgment condition.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Individuals with chronic diarrhea, short bowel syndrome or significant upper gastrointestinal surgery including gastric resection, a history of inflammatory bowel disease (e.g., Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis) or any active bowel inflammation (including diverticulitis), malabsorption syndrome, conditions that would interfere with enteral absorption
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Gastrointestinal disorders affecting absorption are not mapped to typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, organizing pneumonia (e.g., bronchiolitis obliterans), drug-induced pneumonitis, or idiopathic pneumonitis, or evidence of active pneumonitis on the screening chest computed tomography scan
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pulmonary conditions and pneumonitis history are clinical exclusions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Significant cardiovascular disease within 3 months prior to screening
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cardiovascular disease history timeframe is a subjective clinical exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease, as defined by RECIST v1.1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No prior systemic treatment for advanced or metastatic NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior lines restriction phrased as no prior systemic treatment rather than a line count.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Documentation of known PD-L1 expression status in tumor tissue
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Requires documentation of status without a specific numerical cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Symptomatic, untreated, or actively progressing central nervous system (CNS) metastases
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Wording includes symptomatic and actively progressing components which are not a clean typed brain_mets status.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any anti-cancer systemic therapy, including hormonal therapy, within 21 days prior to randomization, or is expected to require any other form of antineoplastic therapy while in the study
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex washout and ongoing therapy restriction.
